title: Zesty Crispy Argentinian Broad Beans Empanadas
description: A kid-friendly Argentinian dish featuring broad beans in a crispy empanada, cooked to perfection in a clay pot and served on a talavera plate, this recipe is kosher-friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the broad beans, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Place a tablespoon of the broad bean mixture onto the center of each empanada dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas in the preheated clay pot and cook for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot on a talavera plate.
Garnish with additional paprika and olive oil if desired.
